---
title: "Analyzing US Births and Basketball Recruits"
author: "Nicholas Tison"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
summary(births |> select(births, year))
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- births |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
nba_recruits <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx")
glimpse(nba_recruits)
```

```{r}
summary(
  nba_recruits |>
    select(rank, nba_mean_ws48, top_mean_wa, total_seasons, drafted)
)
```

```{r}
count(nba_recruits, tier)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
basketball_tibble <- nba_recruits |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c(
        "Never played", "Brief career", "Solid career",
        "All-Star level", "Superstar"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c(
        "#1–10", "#11–25", "#26–50", "#51–100", "Outside top 100"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
plot_data <- basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa))

notable_players <- plot_data |>
  slice_max(top_mean_wa, n = 4, with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = notable_players,
    aes(label = name),
    vjust = -0.7,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Recruit rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added",
    color = "Career tier"
  )
```

```{r}
average_births_by_calendar_position <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(
    average_births = mean(births, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

average_births_by_calendar_position
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  average_births_by_calendar_position,
  aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = average_births)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 5)) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.name) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Mean births") +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = NULL) +
  coord_fixed()
```

```{r}
christmas_data <- births_tibble |>
  filter(
    month == 12,
    date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 25, 27:30)
  ) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    births_december_25 = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    average_surrounding_births = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline =
      100 * births_december_25 / average_surrounding_births,
    day_of_week = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_data
```

```{r}
summary(christmas_data)
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_data, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = day_of_week)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(
  births ~ year + month + day_of_week,
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(
    pct_resid = 100 * residuals(births_model) / mean(births)
  )

str(births_adjusted)
```

```{r}
calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))
  ) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dates <- tibble(
  calendar_date = as.Date(c(
    "2001-01-01", "2001-02-14", "2001-05-28", "2001-07-04",
    "2001-09-03", "2001-11-22", "2001-12-25"
  )),
  holiday = c(
    "New Year's Day", "Valentine's Day", "Memorial Day",
    "Independence Day", "Labor Day", "Thanksgiving", "Christmas Day"
  )
)

holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  inner_join(holiday_dates, by = "calendar_date") |>
  slice_min(mean_pct_resid, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = holiday_dips, color = "firebrick", size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(label = holiday),
    vjust = -0.7,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  labs(
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (% of overall mean)",
    title = "Average daily birth residual across the calendar"
  )
```
